name: pdb-skill
description: Builds replicas of the 1975-76 declassified President's Daily Brief from today's news: multi-source, bilingual (English and Simplified Chinese) briefs typeset as a typewritten booklet PDF with grayscale CIA-style map plates embedded. Markdown output is optional.

output_dir.title: Output folder
output_dir.description: Where briefs are written. By default each brief is a single PDB_<date>.pdf; an Obsidian vault folder works well if you choose Markdown.

output_format.title: Output format
output_format.description: pdf: the 1975-76 replica as one PDF, map plates embedded. markdown: Obsidian-flavored Markdown plus the maps/ folder it links to. both: the PDF and the Markdown.
